children: Longeveron announced ELPIS II topline results showing the Phase 2b trial of laromestrocel in HLHS did not meet its primary endpoint of RVEF improvement at 12 months.
ELPIS II failed primary endpoint: ITT least-squares mean difference in RVEF at Month 12 was −0.7 percentage points (95% CI −7.3 to 5.9; p=0.8336).
Safety profile maintained: no new safety signals; laromestrocel-treated programs total 644 patients across trials.
Exploratory analyses showed no deaths in treated as‑treated group at 12 months vs one in control; long‑term transplant‑free events were 1/17 vs 2/21.
Some exploratory signals: ~31% fewer adjudicated MACE in treated arm (12 vs 19 events) but negative binomial analysis not significant.
Company to conduct additional analyses, discuss results with FDA, and has initiated a strategic review and cost‑containment to maximize shareholder value.
